what_changed: Federal Reserve proposes a third-party risk management guide for traditional community banking organizations, covering key risks in third-party relationships and common relationship categories.
compliant_agent_must_now: No change until final; if adopted, community bank clients would use the guide when conducting due diligence and ongoing monitoring of vendors such as an AI servicing provider.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Which community bank clients are Federal Reserve-supervised, and what evidence packages (SOC reports, model documentation, complaint data) would the guide lead them to request?
rationale: Proposed supervisory guidance on how banks examine third parties; within the vendor-examination part of the test. Stage A: title, abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
